headline: MiRL targets recurring terminal-agent errors during reinforcement learning
summary: A new preprint proposes Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which profiles recurring errors in a terminal agent, resumes training rollouts from replayable prefixes before those errors, and requires both task-test success and avoidance of the target behavior for reward. On Qwen3.5-4B, the authors report 51.8% on Terminal-Bench Lite and 21.3% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 using 35% of TMax-4B's rollouts; a separate 16-seed result strengthens only the Terminal-Bench 2.1 comparison. Results are from one model backbone and no independent reproduction was performed.
